spearman_fedavg.note: Descriptive association on 45 FedAvg jobs; CI resamples the five seeds.

mixedlm.formula: recall ~ monopoly + entropy + C(algorithm) + targeted + monopoly:targeted + C(algorithm):targeted

mixedlm_support_sensitivity.formula: recall ~ monopoly + entropy + C(algorithm) + targeted + monopoly:targeted + C(algorithm):targeted + log_support
mixedlm_support_sensitivity.role: exploratory: protocol LMM plus log test support

gee_binomial_sensitivity.formula: recall ~ monopoly + entropy + C(algorithm) + targeted + monopoly:targeted + C(algorithm):targeted
gee_binomial_sensitivity.method: binomial GEE, independence, clustered by seed, var_weights=support
gee_binomial_sensitivity.warning: Five seed clusters make the sandwich SE a sensitivity check, not a substitute for the LMM.

rq2_alpha_and_dose.role: Secondary analysis after reviews: does monopoly add prediction beyond α, and is that association distinct from poison dose qMc?
rq2_alpha_and_dose.reading: At flip 1.0, Mc equals the globally corrupted source-class fraction by the attacker rule. Across fractions 0.25/0.50/1.0, harm tracks qMc; adding Mc beside qMc does not improve the fit.

lmm_specification_audit.role: Secondary specification audit of the protocol Gaussian LMM. Table 10 remains the protocol fit. Not a Holm family.

collinearity.reading: Monopoly and normalised entropy are two readings of the same five-client share vector; conditional main effects are not separable.

boundary_component.name: klass (class intercept)
boundary_component.note: The class intercept sits on the boundary relative to residual variance. Seed intercept is interior.

paired_source_harm.reading: Direct model of paired source-recall harm on the 90 flip-1.0 jobs. Mc is the poison dose at q=1. Pair fixed effects keep the three locked sources from being treated as 19 independently attacked classes.

aggregator_source_decomposition.note: Secondary. Not a Holm family. Pair-averaged like Table 4. harm_vs_clean_fedavg = clean_source_cost + own_baseline_harm.

visibility_gap_decomposition.note: Secondary. Not a Holm family. Accuracy drop equals the support-weighted sum of class recall changes. F2b (H_s minus accuracy drop) is kept as an operational visibility summary, not as a scientific null that those two scales should match.
